name: javax.validation
suggestion: Rename javax.validation -> jakarta.validation; ensure spring-boot-starter-validation is on the classpath

name: javax.transaction
suggestion: Rename javax.transaction -> jakarta.transaction (or use org.springframework Transactional)

name: WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter
suggestion: REMOVED in Spring Security 6: replace with a @Bean SecurityFilterChain(HttpSecurity) and bean-based AuthenticationManager/UserDetailsService/PasswordEncoder

name: authorizeRequests
suggestion: Replace authorizeRequests() with authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> ...) lambda DSL

name: security.and()-chaining
suggestion: Prefer the lambda DSL instead of chained .and() in HttpSecurity configuration

name: RestTemplate
suggestion: Migrate RestTemplate to RestClient; preserve URI expansion, headers, auth, bodies, response typing, and 4xx/5xx error handling

name: WebMvcConfigurerAdapter
suggestion: REMOVED: implement WebMvcConfigurer interface directly (default methods)

name: Hibernate custom @Type
suggestion: Hibernate 6 changed @Type/UserType API; replace custom types or use standard Jakarta mappings
